description:
Welcome to 000Spark! 🚀 For the NASA Space Apps challenge Be An Earth System Trend Detective!, we are diving into Earth observation data to uncover vital planet shifts.

We bring a mix of creative data visualization, technical problem-solving, and a passion for Earth science.

Looking for: Teammates with skills in coding, data visualization, UI/UX design, or storytelling to help us build an impactful project. Let's make sense of Earth's data together!
summary: EarthTrend is an interactive environmental data explorer built with React and Python. It lets users analyze global Earth science variables (like NDVI, temperature, rainfall, and sea level), run regional comparisons, and calculate statistical trends over time. A great tool for data visualization! 🚀
details:
EarthTrend is an interactive environmental data explorer and learning project built with React and Python.

Key Capabilities:

  • Data Exploration: Filter Earth science variables (such as Vegetation Index, Temperature Anomaly, Rainfall, and Sea Level) across global regions over custom timeframes.
  • Trend Analysis: Instantly compute linear trends, rates of change, and statistical ppp-values.
  • Visualizations & Export: View chronological charts of annual regional averages and export data easily via CSV.
  • Regional Comparison: Compare environmental shifts across different global regions side-by-side.
